panel.title: Help: {screen}
panel.shortcut: Press F1 on any screen to open help for it.
panel.video: Watch the 2-minute video for this task
panel.videoMissing: The 2-minute video for this task is not available yet.

generic.title: This screen
generic.p1: Use the sidebar to move between screens. Your role decides which screens you see.
generic.p2: Press Ctrl+K to search screens and actions by name. Press ? to list the keyboard shortcuts on this screen.
generic.p3: The pill at the top right shows whether you are online. Wait for it to say Online or Live before you rely on a save.

arrivals.title: Today / Arrivals
arrivals.p1: Walk-in: press W (or F2) or the Register walk-in button, search the patient by name or phone, then confirm. A new patient is created from the same dialog.
arrivals.p2: Check-in: find the patient in the Waiting tab or press F4, pick the doctor and the payment method, then check in. The patient joins the queue.
arrivals.p3: Tabs filter the board: Waiting, In consultation, Checkout pending and Completed. The counts update live as other desks work.

schedule.title: Queue & Appointments
schedule.p1: The board shows each doctor's queue and bookings for the day. Register walk-in is the primary action at the top.
schedule.p2: Open a patient row to move them in the queue, reschedule or cancel. Changes made by other desks appear within seconds.

patients.title: Patients
patients.p1: Search by name or phone. The / key focuses the search box from any screen.
patients.p2: Open a patient to see their details, visits and documents. Only what your role may see is shown.

consult.title: Consultation Workspace
consult.p1: The open visit's note, prescriptions, orders and follow-up live in this workspace. Ctrl+S saves the note.
consult.p2: Drafts are kept in this browser until you sign or discard them. Close the visit from the action bar when you are done.

myday.title: My Day
myday.p1: Your queue for today. Start your session so reception can send patients to you; pause it for a break.
myday.p2: Press N to call the next waiting patient. The consult workspace opens with their visit.

nursing.title: Triage & Vitals
nursing.p1: Capture vitals from the top-bar button or from a patient row. Mark a patient urgent from the row when they need the doctor first.
nursing.p2: The tabs hold nursing orders, today's procedures, vaccines and injections, priority patients and completed activity.

overview.title: Overview
overview.p1: Today's clinic at a glance: who is waiting, what was billed and what needs your attention.
overview.p2: Start day close from the top bar when the last patient has checked out. The sidebar sections group everything you can set up.

billing.title: Checkout & Billing
billing.p1: Patients whose consult is finished wait in the checkout queue. Open one to review the charges and take payment.
billing.p2: Day close reconciles the day's collections. It needs the billing approval permission.

pharmacy.title: Pharmacy
pharmacy.p1: Prescriptions sent by doctors wait in the dispense queue; counter sales go through POS.
pharmacy.p2: Stock, expiry and purchases are under their own tabs.

requests.title: Booking requests
requests.p1: Requests that came in from WhatsApp or the booking page. Accept one to turn it into a booking or decline it with a reason.

setup.title: Clinic Setup
setup.p1: Clinic details, hours, doctors, services and prices. Each tab saves on its own.

staff.title: Staff & Access
staff.p1: Invite staff, assign roles and remove access. What a person can do comes from their role.

reports.title: Reports
reports.p1: Daily and monthly figures for the clinic. Pick a date range and export when you need a file.

s1.title: Welcome to the front desk
s1.body: This short tour shows the five things you do most on Today / Arrivals. You can skip it any time and replay it from the account menu.

s2.title: Register a walk-in
s2.body: Press W or the Register walk-in button at the top. Search the patient by name or phone; if they are new, create them in the same dialog.

s3.title: Check a patient in
s3.body: Find the patient in the Waiting tab (or press F4), pick the doctor and the payment method, then check in. They join the doctor's queue.

s4.title: Follow the board
s4.body: The tabs show who is waiting, in consultation, pending checkout or done. The counts update by themselves as the day moves.

s5.title: Help is one key away
s5.body: Press F1 on any screen for help about it, ? for the keyboard shortcuts and Ctrl+K to find any screen or action by name.

s1.title: Welcome to Triage & Vitals
s1.body: This short tour shows how the nursing screens work. Skip any time; replay from the account menu.

s2.title: Capture vitals
s2.body: Use the Capture vitals button at the top or open a waiting patient's row. Saved vitals appear on the doctor's screen at once.

s3.title: Flag an urgent patient
s3.body: From a patient row, mark them urgent with a reason. The doctor's queue shows them first.

s4.title: Orders, procedures, vaccines
s4.body: The tabs hold today's nursing orders, procedures and vaccines; priority patients and completed activity have their own tabs.

s5.title: Help is one key away
s5.body: Press F1 on any screen for help about it, ? for the keyboard shortcuts and Ctrl+K to find any screen or action by name.

s1.title: Welcome to My Day
s1.body: This short tour shows your day from the queue to the signed note. Skip any time; replay from the account menu.

s2.title: Start your session
s2.body: Start your session so reception can send patients to you. Pause it for a break and end it when you leave.

s3.title: Call the next patient
s3.body: Press N or the call-next button. The consult workspace opens with that patient's visit.

s4.title: Write and sign
s4.body: Note, prescription, orders and follow-up are in the consult workspace. Ctrl+S saves; signing closes the visit and sends the patient to checkout.

s5.title: Help is one key away
s5.body: Press F1 on any screen for help about it, ? for the keyboard shortcuts and Ctrl+K to find any screen or action by name.

s1.title: Welcome to your clinic
s1.body: This short tour shows where the owner's screens are. Skip any time; replay from the account menu.

s2.title: Overview
s2.body: Today's clinic at a glance: waiting patients, collections and what needs attention.

s3.title: Run, People, Money
s3.body: The sidebar groups your screens: run the clinic, people and access, money, growth and compliance.

s4.title: Close the day
s4.body: Start day close from the top bar once the last patient has checked out. It reconciles the day's collections.

s5.title: Help is one key away
s5.body: Press F1 on any screen for help about it, ? for the keyboard shortcuts and Ctrl+K to find any screen or action by name.

competency.title: Front-desk competency check
competency.hint: Do each task once with your trainer watching, then tick it. Finish all ten before you run the desk on your own.
competency.saveFailed: Couldn't save that tick. Try again.

tasks.walkin: Register a walk-in patient (new and returning)
tasks.checkin: Check in a booked patient with the right doctor and payment method
tasks.queue: Move a patient to the next step in the queue
tasks.requests: Accept or decline a booking request
tasks.delay: Send a delay message to waiting patients
tasks.checkout: Take payment at checkout and hand over the receipt
tasks.noshow: Mark a patient as a no-show
tasks.search: Find a patient by name or phone and open their record
tasks.offline: Recognise when the app is offline, and that payments must wait
